variants.title: Absorption and fluorescence of fluorescein
variants.note: A small Stokes shift: absorption and emission bands overlap.

source.title: Fluorescein in 0.1 M NaOH: absorption 490 nm, emission about 514 nm (PhotochemCAD; Lakowicz, Principles of Fluorescence Spectroscopy)

variants.title: Absorption and fluorescence of ruby
variants.note: The Y absorption band near 550 nm feeds the sharp R1 emission line at 694.3 nm.

source.title: Ruby: Y band near 550 nm, R1 line 694.3 nm (Maiman 1960; Koechner, Solid-State Laser Engineering)
